5364.title: Pi discovery stops before nested skills
5364.rootCauseOneLine: Pi roots default to shallow discovery; the recursive walker also skips linked bundle entries.
5364.proposedFix: Repair recursive Pi root policy and supported user-link traversal together, preserving project boundaries and scan bounds.
5364.caveats: Source-only Linux reproduction, not the installed macOS app or a custom provider. Provider-only recursion regresses user symlinks; no PR was pushed. Reproduction sources are embedded inline under public repository policy.
